brief: Lancelot Andrewes, born in 1555, was the saintly Bishop of Winchester who by example, preaching and writing brought to the Church of England high standards of holiness of life and wholehearted service. He was one of the translators of the Authorised Version of the Bible, and did much to foster a distinctive Anglican theology that took account of Scripture, reason and tradition. He died in 1626 and is buried in what is now Southwark Cathedral.
